verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable API specification for the Vonage Video API that a user could download. The llms.txt file exists (HTTP 200), but it is an LLM-oriented documentation index, not an API spec, so it earns no credit. The per-page markdown docs probe returned 404. The axis clearly applies to an API platform, so absence of evidence yields none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
